segments.name: Risk Capital

segments.evidence: We manage our business within two reportable segments: Risk Capital and Human Capital.

segments.name: Human Capital
segments.description: Delivers health and benefits brokerage, talent advisory, retirement consulting, pension administration, and investment advice to employers and institutions.
segments.evidence: Human Capital Health Solutions includes consulting and brokerage, consumer benefits, compensation, and talent advisory services.

revenueModel.evidence: Our business generates revenues primarily through commissions, compensation from insurance and reinsurance companies for services we provide to them, and fees from customers.
